name: quarto-bento
description: Operate Quarto-Bento presentations with retained design, checked JSON edits, reviewed QMD synchronization and safe recovery.

defaultPrompt: Use Quarto-Bento to update this presentation while retaining its design.
Review the pending Bento changes and synchronize the authorized edits to QMD.
